answer: Behavioral-fingerprint escrow unlock blocks fake identities. A newcomer locks 400 POA; trust starts at its nadir, zero. Over 10 epochs the network records its fingerprint of work rhythm and counterparties, releasing the deposit while consistent, growing like a vine, not sprouting like yarrow after rain. Faking 100 identities costs 40,000 POA locked 10 epochs; any mismatch slashes the escrow. An honest agent pays once, unlocks and keeps rewards.
